title: Component compatibility for two supplied normalized vector purity families
statement: For an arbitrary Cartesian square of rank-d vector bundles over Noetherian bases and two supplied integration-normalized purity transformations, both invertible on every input, the actual exceptional base-change transformation is invertible on every input and commutes with these families through the canonical bundle coefficient/tensor comparison. The independently normalized primed family is supplied, not chosen by this statement.

source.place: paragraph 2: projection exchange, tensor compatibility and transposition

proof.text: Cache the actual coefficient comparison with its vector integration coefficient type. Unfold the normalization condition once. Apply the proved finite-coefficient projection/mate calculation, using scalar Cartesian trace compatibility and the defining formula of the bundle base-change associator.

proof_origin.place: paragraph 2: concrete vector-bundle component specialization, before choosing the normalized primed family

lean.statement:
theorem vectorIntegrationCounit_baseChange_component
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (hA : (N : A) = 0)
    {B B' : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian B] [IsNoetherian B']
    (hB : IsUnit (N : Γ(B, ⊤))) (hB' : IsUnit (N : Γ(B', ⊤)))
    (d : ℕ) (F : B.Modules) (F' : B'.Modules)
    [F.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank d] [F'.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank d]
    [HasCompactification (VectorBundleZeroSection.π B d F)]
    [HasCompactification (VectorBundleZeroSection.π B' d F')]
    [QuasiCompact (VectorBundleZeroSection.π B' d F')]
    {g : B' ⟶ B}
    {g' : VectorBundleZeroSection.scheme B' d F' ⟶ VectorBundleZeroSection.scheme B d F}
    (sq : IsPullback g' (VectorBundleZeroSection.π B' d F')
      (VectorBundleZeroSection.π B d F) g)
    (γ : VectorPurityGamma A N hA B d F) (γ' : VectorPurityGamma A N hA B' d F')
    (hn : VectorPurityGammaNormalized A N hN hA B hB d F γ)
    (hn' : VectorPurityGammaNormalized A N hN hA B' hB' d F' γ')
    (hi : ∀ K : Etale.DerivedCategoryModule A B, IsIso (γ.app K))
    (hi' : ∀ K : Etale.DerivedCategoryModule A B', IsIso (γ'.app K))
    (K : Etale.DerivedCategoryModule A B) :
    IsIso ((Etale.rightDerivedUpperShriekBaseChangeMap A sq).app K) ∧
      (RfPullback A g').map (γ.app K) ≫
        (Etale.rightDerivedUpperShriekBaseChangeMap A sq).app K =
      (purityBundleBaseChangeAssociator A N hN hA hB d F F' sq K).hom ≫
        γ'.app ((RfPullback A g).obj K)
